description: Create a scheduled job that runs a Chaprola endpoint on a recurring cron. Max 10 schedules/user, 15-min minimum interval

body.description: JSON object of the schedule request body. userid is injected automatically

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (min hour day month weekday). Minimum interval: 15 minutes

name.description: Unique name for this schedule (alphanumeric + hyphens/underscores)

skip_if_unchanged.description: Skip when response matches previous run (SHA-256 hash). Default: false

name: chaprola_schedule
